codeReview.summary: Clean, well-structured implementation of the StageContext accumulator. The stage-context.ts module defines a Zod schema, factory/reset functions, an immutable accumulation function, and persistence via atomicWrite. Integration into ExecutionLoop is correct: context is accumulated after each phase's handoff is read, persisted to disk with try/catch error handling, and passed to the dispatcher only when non-empty (phase_count > 0). The 'reset between stages' requirement is met by each new ExecutionLoop starting with createEmptyStageContext(). Tests are comprehensive (22 stage-context + 5 dispatcher), covering schema validation, single/multi/50+/100 phase accumulation, immutability, persistence roundtrips, and error handling. The code follows existing project conventions (Zod schemas, Log module, atomicWrite, TypeScript strict mode).

issues.description: resetStageContext() method is defined but never called anywhere in the codebase. The reset-between-stages behavior works because each pipeline stage creates a new ExecutionLoop instance (which initializes with empty context), making this method dead code. It's harmless but could mislead future maintainers into thinking it needs to be called explicitly.

The standalone resetStageContext() function is also unused — it's just an alias for createEmptyStageContext(). Since ExecutionLoop.resetStageContext() already exists as a method AND each new loop starts fresh, this top-level function adds no value. Minor redundancy.

The stage-context.json file on disk is never cleaned up when a new stage begins. Currently safe because resumeStageContext defaults to false and is never passed as true, but if resume support is enabled later, a new stage could accidentally load stale context from a completed previous stage. A cleanup step (delete file) when starting a new ExecutionLoop without resumeStageContext would be more defensive.

The PhaseDecisionsSchema, PhaseWarningsSchema, PhaseArtifactsSchema, and PhaseIssuesSchema all share the same shape (phase_index + phase_title + array-of-strings field). This is fine for clarity but could be DRY-ed with a generic helper. Very minor style observation.

SkillFeedbackEntrySchema re-defines the deviation shape inline rather than importing SkillDeviationSchema from src/schemas/handoff.ts. The shapes match currently, but if the handoff schema evolves, these could drift apart. Consider importing from the canonical source for DRY-ness.

summary: PASS. The cumulative stage context feature is well-implemented and fully covers the expected behaviors: StageContext type with all required fields, immutable accumulation after each phase, persistence to disk via atomicWrite, resume support (opt-in), DispatcherInput wiring, reset between stages (via new ExecutionLoop instances), and 50+/100 phase stress tests. Five non-blocking issues identified: dead code (resetStageContext method/function never called), no disk cleanup between stages, minor schema duplication. All issues are cosmetic or future-proofing concerns — no functional bugs or blocking problems found.
